entities.name: Gustavo Rodolfo Mendoza Hernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gustavo Rodolfo Mendoza Hernández is a Guatemalan clergyman and emeritus Roman Catholic auxiliary bishop in Guatemala. Pope John Paul II appointed him on July 9, 2004 as auxiliary bishop of the archbishopric of Guatemala and titular bishop of Selemselae. On 11 November 2016, he resigned, citing his age.
